name: Zacian & Zamazenta vs Eternatus Special Deck Set

releases.name: Zacian & Zamazenta vs Eternatus Special Deck Set

description.text: Special Deck Set Zacian & Zamazenta vs Eternatus, released on 5 November 2021: two 60-card decks that replay the battle of Pokémon Sword and Shield, a Metal deck with Zacian V and Zamazenta V against an Eternatus VMAX deck of Darkness Pokémon. Shiny Zacian V and shiny Zamazenta V came in every box. With two deck cases, a playmat, coins, damage counters and a card box, it was offered as a year-end gift.
